explication: Stripe Ruby is an SDK for calling Stripe’s API from Ruby applications. The principal workflow is: an application configures a Stripe client, selects a generated service, supplies parameters, and receives a dynamically hydrated resource or list. Services delegate HTTP work to the request and connection layers, which provide serialization, retries/configuration, instrumentation, and errors. The tree also includes specialized service families, OAuth, event models, pagination support, and test-mode Issuing endpoints. Some central wiring is inferred from the public API and sampled service calls; unsampled internals are not expanded.
